title: DATA-QUALITY: catalog bioelectric_polarity empirical curves are alpha-template artifacts (BIO-TPL-DQ-01)
instructions: Determine from primary in-repo evidence whether the three named bioelectric_polarity empirical curves are actually alpha_scale templates rather than biological observations.
Do not fabricate replacement biological data and do not silently overwrite empirical_series values.

If the claim is confirmed, quarantine it in a durable machine-readable way: add a focused checker plus a data-quality audit artifact that names every affected dataset, the exact correlations, and which downstream claims must not cite those curves as biological evidence.

If a legitimate non-template biological source is already present and merely mislabelled, correct only the provenance labelling and cite the source record; if replacement data would have to be invented or fetched ambiguously, report blocked instead of guessing.
